extensionDescription.message: AI-powered instant speech translation for all video meetings. Break language barriers with real-time voice translation.

clickToStart.message: Click "Open MAO Chat" below to start real-time translation.

quickStartInstructions.message: Configure your API key (OpenAI or Gemini) → Select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" as microphone → Start speaking!

gatherTownGuidance.message: Za uporabo MAO Chatja izberite "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" v nastavitvah mikrofona.

wherebyGuidance.message: Za uporabo MAO Chat prosimo izberite "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" v nastavitvah mikrofona in onemogočite zmanjševanje hrupa za boljšo zmogljivost.

defaultGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings.

discordGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat, please select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your microphone settings and disable Noise Suppression in Discord's Voice settings for better performance.

slackGuidance.message: To use MAO Chat in Slack Huddles, please start a Huddle, then select "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" in your Video and Mic settings, and disable Noise Suppression in Audio & Video preferences for better performance.

teamsGuidance.message:
Če ne vidite celotnega seznama zvočnih naprav v nastavitvah Teamsa:
1) Začasno onemogočite razširitev MAO Chat in osvežite stran
2) Ko boste pozvani, dovolite Teamsu dostop do mikrofona in kamere
3) Ponovno omogočite razširitev MAO Chat in ponovno osvežite stran
4) Ko boste pozvani, dovolite MAO Chatju dostop do mikrofona. Zdaj bi morali videti tako prave naprave kot "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" v nastavitvah.

jitsiGuidance.message: Če želite uporabljati MAO Chat v Jitsi Meet, odprite Settings > Devices in izberite "MAO Chat Virtual Microphone" kot svoj mikrofon. Nato odprite Advanced audio settings in izklopite odpravljanje šuma, odpravljanje odmeva in samodejno nastavljanje ojačanja za čist preveden zvok.

unsupportedHeadline.message: MAO Chat na $HOSTNAME$ še ni na voljo.

desktopCtaBody.message: Sistemski virtualni mikrofon za OBS, YouTube, Twitch in katero koli namizno aplikacijo. Windows · macOS · Linux.

browserSitesHeading.message: Imate raje brskalnik? MAO Chat deluje na teh straneh — kliknite za odpiranje:

detectFailHeadline.message: Te zavihka ni bilo mogoče zaznati

detectFailBody.message: Osvežite stran in znova odprite MAO Chat.
